nodes.summary: A connection is a linear differential operator on vector-bundle sections with a scalar Leibniz rule.
nodes.normalized_claim: For every local scalar f and section s, nabla(f*s) = df tensor s + f*nabla(s).
nodes.formalization_target: Map the existing covariant-derivative interface before any new declaration.

nodes.summary: In a local frame, the curvature form is d(gamma) + gamma wedge gamma.
nodes.normalized_claim: Omega = d(gamma) + gamma wedge gamma is frame-covariant and its vanishing is basis-independent.
nodes.formalization_target: Boundary-only mapping to bundle-valued differential forms; no declaration admission.

nodes.summary: Curvature is an endomorphism-valued two-form independent of the local frame.
nodes.normalized_claim: R(u,v) is alternating in tangent arguments and acts linearly on a section value.
nodes.formalization_target: Reference-only comparison against the overlapping upstream curvature API.

nodes.summary: Metric-compatible curvature is skew-adjoint rather than an arbitrary endomorphism.
nodes.normalized_claim: For a metric-compatible connection, each curvature value is skew-adjoint with respect to the metric.
nodes.formalization_target: Semantic comparison only; no duplicate theorem proposal while the overlap blocker remains active.

feedback_gates.challenged_conclusion: R(u,v) = R(v,u) for arbitrary tangent vectors.
feedback_gates.concrete_witness: On the trivial line bundle over R^2 with connection form gamma = x dy, Omega = dx wedge dy, so R(partial_x,partial_y) is the negative of R(partial_y,partial_x) when nonzero.

graphs.domain: abstract variational PDE Galerkin orthogonality and Cea bound

source.rationale: No official local textbook asset has been selected for this domain, so the dependency graph is a source-requested candidate rather than a textbook-aligned statement pipeline.
source.proposed_work: Open-licensed abstract variational PDE source to be selected by a source analyst

mathlib_census.scope: Lax--Milgram, distributions, Sobolev spaces, and active weak-derivative work.
mathlib_census.observation: The abstract route may reuse Lax--Milgram, while concrete Sobolev work is unstable around PR #32305. This is not a statement that no alternative Cea formalization exists.

nodes.summary: Fix a Hilbert space and a continuous bilinear form before introducing a PDE instance.
nodes.normalized_claim: The variational problem is posed on a Hilbert space V with bilinear form a and linear functional ell.
nodes.formalization_target: Reuse existing inner-product and continuous-linear-map APIs where the census confirms them.

nodes.summary: State coercivity explicitly rather than inferring stability from continuity.
nodes.normalized_claim: There exists alpha > 0 such that alpha*norm(v)^2 <= a(v,v) for every v.
nodes.formalization_target: Map to the exact Lax--Milgram hypotheses after source and API review.

nodes.summary: Define the finite-dimensional trial subspace and Galerkin solution.
nodes.normalized_claim: The Galerkin solution satisfies a(u-u_h,v_h)=0 for every v_h in the selected subspace.
nodes.formalization_target: Keep finite-dimensional approximation and concrete PDE regularity outside the first contract.

nodes.summary: Establish the abstract quasi-optimality estimate only after all constants are explicit.
nodes.normalized_claim: norm(u-u_h) <= (M/alpha) * inf_{v_h} norm(u-v_h), under continuity M and coercivity alpha.
nodes.formalization_target: A library-gap draft only; no concrete Sobolev or domain theorem is implied.

feedback_gates.challenged_conclusion: Continuity alone guarantees existence and the Cea estimate.
feedback_gates.concrete_witness: On V=R, take a(u,v)=0 and ell(v)=v. The form is continuous but the variational equation has no solution, so the stability conclusion is invalid.
